name: CinemaCity Download Lab
description: CinemaCity Download Lab 1.7.0. DUI7 dumps the bodies and call sites of the download orchestration functions (getProtectedDownloadTarget / parseFileSet / startDownload / getSelectedQualityIndex / currentFileSet) so the base URL and video/audio source can be read without repeating the DUI6 inventory sweep.
